description: Watch rivers across the US with the National Weather Service's river gauges: list the gauges in a state that are flooding or forecast to flood, read a gauge's latest level, forecast, flood stages and what floods at each level, see past crests and the gauges up and down the river, get the National Water Model's streamflow forecasts, and run a workflow when a gauge reaches a flood category. No account or API key required.

noaa_nwps_flood_category_trigger.description: Triggers when a river gauge's latest reading, its forecast, or either rises to or above the flood category you choose. It triggers once on the way up, and again only after the river falls back below that category. A gauge already there when you turn it on doesn't trigger it. It checks every few minutes.
